name: @iris/core
description: The logic both Iris clients run. Pure: no I/O, no platform APIs, no Node built-ins — so it loads in Electron and in JavaScriptCore alike.
//type: No "type": "module". The build emits CommonJS because that is what Electron's main process requires; declaring the package ESM makes Node treat dist/*.js as ESM and it fails on `exports is not defined`. Sources are ESM-authored and vitest transpiles them.
